speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; please describe the exact appearance and distribution of the rash. REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, ANA, RF, Anti-CCP, and Serum ACE. REQUEST IMAGES: Palms_close_up.

speaker: Doctor
text: The initial workup results are normal. Can you tell me if the rash on your palms is scaly, blistering, or vesicular, and does it also appear on the soles of your feet?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome. The patient's occupation (rice farm, livestock care) combined with the specific symptom of numbness/tingling on the palms (peripheral neuropathy) is highly characteristic of Hantavirus infection. I recommend immediate isolation and consultation with infectious disease specialists for confirmation via RT-PCR.
